map.对比 S 型（穿越式）与 U 型（返回式）拣货路径的行走距离与耗时，帮助选择更优: Compares the walking distance and time of S-shaped (traversal) and U-shaped (return) picking routes to help choose the better picking strategy.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：(saving ÷ max(sTotalTime,: Core formula (by input variables): (saving ÷ max(sTotalTime, uTotalTime) × 100); (aisles - 1) × aisleGap; |(sTotalTime - uTotalTime)|

map.拣货员沿通道行进，到端部后进入下一相邻通道，形成连续 S 形轨迹。适合拣货点分布: The picker moves along an aisle, enters the next adjacent aisle at the end, and forms a continuous S-shaped path. Suited to evenly distributed pick points and long aisles, with a continuous route and no backtracking.
map.拣货员进入通道拣货后原路返回，从同一端进入下一通道。适合拣货点集中在通道一端、通: The picker enters an aisle, picks, then returns the same way and enters the next aisle from the same end. Suited to pick points concentrated at one end of the aisle, short aisles, or picking order by order.
map.路径距离为理论估算，假设出入口位于第一通道前端、拣货点均匀分布。实际距离受货位分: Route distance is a theoretical estimate, assuming the entrance and exit are at the front of the first aisle and that pick points are evenly distributed. Actual distance is affected by slot layout, turning to reach goods and other factors.
map.S 型（穿越式）与 U 型（返回式）定量对比：S 型通道内行走距离=通道数×通道: Quantitative comparison of S-shape (traversal) and U-shape (return): in-aisle walking distance for S-shape = number of aisles × aisle length, and for U-shape = 2 × number of aisles × aisle length (each aisle is entered and then retraced); the cross-aisle distance is the same for both, namely (number of aisles − 1) × aisle spacing.
map.行走与拣货耗时拆分：行走耗时=总行走距离÷行走速度，拣货耗时=拣货点总数×单点拣: Breaking down walking and picking time: walking time = total walking distance ÷ walking speed, picking time = total pick points × time per pick point (total pick points = number of aisles × pick points per aisle); picking time does not depend on the route, so the entire difference comes from walking distance.
map.方案落地与复核：工具取总耗时较小者作为推荐路径，节省: Implementation and review: the tool recommends the route with the smaller total time, with the saving
map.=两路径总耗时之差÷较大值×100；输出结果后应结合通道实际是否全部需要进入、拣: = the difference in total time between the two routes ÷ the larger value × 100; after reading the output, review manually whether every aisle really has to be entered and whether pick points are evenly distributed, and if necessary work out by hand the case where only some aisles are walked.
map.算例：8 通道仓库的 S 型 vs U 型对比: Worked example: S-shape vs U-shape in an 8-aisle warehouse
map.输入：通道数 8、通道长 20 m、通道间距 3 m、行走速度 1.2 m/s、: Input: 8 aisles, aisle length 20 m, aisle spacing 3 m, walking speed 1.2 m/s, 10 s per pick point, 3 pick points per aisle. Total pick points = 8 × 3 = 24, picking time = 24 × 10 = 240 s. S-shape: in-aisle 8 × 20 = 160 m, cross-aisle (8 − 1) × 3 = 21 m, total 181.0 m, walking 150.83 s, total time 390.83 s (6 min 31 s). U-shape: in-aisle 8 × 20 × 2 = 320 m, cross-aisle 21 m, total 341.0 m, walking 284.17 s, total time 524.17 s (8 min 44 s). Conclusion: S-shape is recommended, saving 133.33 s, a saving ratio of 25.4%. With another set of parameters (4 aisles, length 30 m, spacing 3 m, 1.2 m/s, 15 s per point, 5 points per aisle) S-shape is 407.5 s and U-shape 507.5 s, a saving of 100.0 s (19.7%).
map.什么情况下 U 型反而更优？: When is the U-shape actually better?
map.当拣货点集中在少数通道、或通道很长而横向间距很小、且允许只进入需要拣货的通道时，: When pick points are concentrated in a few aisles, or aisles are very long while the cross-aisle spacing is very small, and only the aisles that need picking may be entered, the U-shape can skip irrelevant aisles and end up shorter. This tool, however, models every aisle as entered and walked in full, so the U-shape distance is always twice the S-shape in-aisle distance and S-shape always wins under this model; if the real operation only walks part of the aisles, convert manually using the actual number of aisles.
map.为什么两条路径的拣货耗时是一样的？: Why is the picking time the same for both routes?
map.拣货点总数由通道数与每通道拣货点决定，单点拣货时间也是固定输入，都不随路径策略变: The total number of pick points is set by the number of aisles and the pick points per aisle, and the time per pick point is also a fixed input; neither changes with the route strategy, so picking time is the same. This means route optimization can only compress walking time; if the efficiency bottleneck comes from the picking action itself (such as unpacking, scanning or labelling), the fix lies in workstation layout or packaging method.
map.拣货路径对比是一款旅行出行领域的在线工具。旅行出行工具，出行必备，支持离线使用。: Picking route comparison is an online tool in the travel field. Travel tools are essential for going out and support offline use.
map.推荐 = 总耗时较小者；节省比例 = |S−U| ÷ max(S,U) × 10: Recommended = the one with the shorter total time; savings ratio = |S−U| ÷ max(S,U) × 100%
map.拣货路径 S 型 / U 型对比模型: Picking Route S-Shape / U-Shape Comparison Model
map.总拣货点 = 通道数 × 每通道拣货点数: Total pick points = aisles × pick points per aisle
map.总拣货耗时 = 总拣货点 × 单点拣货时间: Total picking time = total pick points × time per pick
map.S 型（穿越式）：通道内距离 = 通道数 × 通道长；横向距离 = (通道数−1: S-shape (traversal): in-aisle distance = aisles × aisle length; cross distance = (aisles − 1) × aisle spacing
map.U 型（返回式）：通道内距离 = 通道数 × 通道长 × 2；横向距离同 S 型: U-shape (return): in-aisle distance = aisles × aisle length × 2; cross distance same as S-shape
map.总距离 = 通道内 + 横向；行走耗时 = 总距离 ÷ 行走速度: Total distance = in-aisle + cross; travel time = total distance ÷ travel speed
map.总耗时 = 行走耗时 + 拣货耗时: Total time = travel time + picking time
map.选型原则：通道长、拣货点分布均匀时穿越式更优: Selection rule: with long aisles and evenly distributed pick points, traversal is better
map.通道短或拣货点集中时返回式更优: With short aisles or concentrated pick points, the return route is better
map.时间格式：<60s 显示秒，否则 分+秒: Time format: under 60 s shows seconds, otherwise minutes + seconds
map.U 型（最远拣货点折返）：通道内距离 = 通道数 × 通道长 × 最远拣货点比例: U-shape (turn back at farthest pick point): in-aisle distance = aisles × aisle length × farthest pick ratio × 2; cross-aisle distance same as S-shape
map.S 型末端返回距离单列计入；U 型每次返回入口，无末端返回: The S-shape end return distance is added separately; the U-shape returns to the entrance each time, with no end return
map.选型原则：仅在“每通道最远拣货点比例相同”的示意模型下比较；实际需用真实货位分布: Selection principle: compare only under the illustrative model where every aisle has the same farthest pick ratio; real decisions need actual slot distribution
map.路径距离为示意模型：假设出入口位于第一通道前端，所有通道采用同一“最远拣货点比例: Route distance is an illustrative model: the entrance is at the front of the first aisle, every aisle uses the same farthest pick ratio, and cross-aisle connections are identical. Actual distance depends on each aisle's slot layout, two-way aisles, end detours and congestion; this cannot be claimed as a universally optimal route.
map.S 型（穿越式）与 U 型（最远拣货点折返）示意对比：S 型通道内行走距离=通道: Illustrative comparison of S-shape (traversal) and U-shape (turn back at farthest pick point): S-shape in-aisle distance = aisles × aisle length; U-shape = 2 × aisles × aisle length × farthest pick ratio, with the ratio supplied as input instead of fixed at 100%. Cross-aisle distance is the same for both: (aisles − 1) × aisle spacing; S-shape also adds the end return to the entrance.
map.算例：8 通道仓库的 S 型 vs U 型示意对比: Worked example: illustrative S-shape vs U-shape comparison in an 8-aisle warehouse
map.输入：通道数 8、通道长 20 m、通道间距 3 m、行走速度 1.2 m/s、: Input: 8 aisles, aisle length 20 m, aisle spacing 3 m, walking speed 1.2 m/s, 10 s per pick point, 3 pick points per aisle, farthest pick ratio 60%, S-shape end return 0 m. Total pick points = 8 × 3 = 24; picking time = 24 × 10 = 240 s. S-shape: in-aisle 8 × 20 = 160.0 m, cross-aisle (8 − 1) × 3 = 21.0 m, total 181.0 m, walking 150.83 s, total time 390.83 s (6 min 31 s). U-shape: in-aisle 8 × 20 × 0.6 × 2 = 192.0 m, cross-aisle 21.0 m, total 213.0 m, walking 177.50 s, total time 417.50 s (6 min 58 s). Under this model S-shape is 26.67 s faster (6.4%). If the farthest pick point is only at 20% of the aisle, U-shape in-aisle = 64.0 m, total 85.0 m, total time 310.83 s, which is 80.0 s faster than S-shape (20.5%). With another set (4 aisles, length 30 m, spacing 3 m, 1.2 m/s, 15 s per point, 5 points per aisle, 60% turn-back), S-shape is 407.5 s and U-shape 427.5 s, so S-shape is 20.0 s faster (4.7%). These conclusions hold only under the stated assumptions and cannot replace real warehouse data.
map.当每通道最远拣货点不到通道长度的一半时，U 型按 2×最远点折返，通道内距离会短: When the farthest pick point in each aisle is less than half the aisle length, the U-shape turns back at twice that point, so its in-aisle distance is shorter than the S-shape walking the full aisle; if the S-shape must also return from the end to the entrance, the gap grows. Conversely, when pick points are near the aisle end, the U-shape in-aisle distance approaches twice the S-shape and S-shape is better. The tool asks for one common farthest pick ratio and gives only an illustrative conclusion; real warehouses should use each aisle's actual farthest slot or on-site time studies.
